offset_unit: unicode code points into the exact request string
generated_by: python3, len(str) for code points, len(str.encode()) for bytes

cases.name: ascii_baseline
cases.note: Bytes and code points agree. A provider that gets this right and nothing else has proven nothing.

cases.name: cjk_bytes_disagree
cases.text: こんにちは、私は John Smith です。電話は 415-555-0134
cases.note: The #3146 string: 39 code points, 67 bytes. Byte offsets for PHONE_NUMBER are [55,67), past the end of a code-point string.

cases.name: astral_plane_emoji
cases.note: U+1F4DE is one code point, two UTF-16 code units, four UTF-8 bytes. A JavaScript or Java provider using string length will report start one too high.

cases.name: combining_mark_grapheme_ne_codepoint
cases.text: Contact José Alvarez at the front desk.
cases.note: 'é' as e + U+0301 is one grapheme, two code points. Grapheme-counting providers report end one too low. Unit is code points, not graphemes.

cases.name: span_at_offset_zero
cases.note: start == 0 must round-trip. omitempty on a plain int dropped this before #3147.

cases.name: span_at_end_of_text
cases.note: end == len(text) is valid; end == len(text)+1 is not.

cases.name: overlap_different_types
cases.text: Reach me at mailto:jane@example.org for details.
cases.note: Overlap of different types is permitted. Masking must cover the union, not the first match.

cases.name: nested_same_direction
cases.text: Send it to John Smith, 12 Baker Street, London.
cases.note: PERSON strictly inside ADDRESS. Both reported; neither merged into the other.

cases.name: duplicate_span_rejected
cases.note: Identical (label,start,end) twice. Reject, do not dedupe silently.

cases.name: text_mismatch_rejected
cases.note: text must equal the code-point slice [start,end). The mismatch is how an off-by-one in the unit shows up.

cases.name: unknown_label_rejected
cases.note: Label not in the configured PII mapping. Reject, as label_distribution.v1 does; a provider's taxonomy is not silently trusted.
